name: Corto cinematográfico (escenas, poca letra, letterbox)
source: Estilo de Sergio, 28 oct. 2026: gramática de cortometraje (planos que respiran, silencio, imagen final).
grade: Cinematic teal and orange or cold desaturated; deep blacks, soft highlights, grain.
typography: Thin elegant title, small lower-third lines; no captions on most shots.
narration: High-energy host narration driving the timeline, rules, stakes and emotional beats.
music: Dynamic orchestral score, cinematic bass drops, upbeat YouTube challenge tracks, punchy SFX for counters.
look: Letterboxed 2.39:1, cinematic real footage and film scenes, shallow depth of field, motivated light, slow camera moves, a recurring image that returns at the end.
camera: Slow dolly and push-ins, wide establishing shots, intimate close-ups, still frames held.
viral: An image in the first second that asks a question.
An ending image that answers the first.
